mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 3 months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic contraction.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter, it signals strong consumer demand, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in past quarter
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs over the past month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a tight monetary policy in a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to potential economic overheating.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy in strong labor market
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% over the past quarter signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS decreases by more than 1%.
